lines.text: Which 150 dollar engine can actually keep up with a 600 dollar Honda?
ai: two red small gas engines facing off on a garage floor under dramatic light

lines.text: The clone copies Honda's red paint and its sticker says 7.5 horsepower against the real one's 5.5.
ai: a shiny red small gas engine with a big horsepower sticker

lines.text: But a sticker is just a sticker so the only way to know is to test it.
ai: a peeling sticker on a red engine macro
a stopwatch and a test bench in a workshop

lines.text: On the vibration tester the clone shakes so hard the meter can't even read it.
ai: a small engine shaking violently with motion blur

lines.text: Because a one cylinder engine needs a weighted crankshaft to cancel its own shake and the clone skipped that.
ai: a steel crankshaft with heavy counterweights spinning macro
a washing machine shaking violently on a tiled floor
cutaway of a single cylinder engine piston and crankshaft

lines.text: Then it burns six ounces of oil a day so he tops it up twice like a leaky boat.
ai: a leaky wooden boat taking on water
golden motor oil pouring from a bottle into an engine

lines.text: That oil sneaks past the piston rings and burns which is why its spark plug is caked in carbon.
ai: macro of a spark plug caked in black carbon
oil sneaking past a piston ring inside an engine cylinder macro

lines.text: And on the pull test the clone makes 200 pounds while the weaker sounding Honda makes 239.
ai: a thick rope pulled tight with tension and dust

lines.text: But here's the twist because Harbor Freight's 150 dollar Predator pulls 233.
ai: a red small engine under a spotlight with a plot twist mood

lines.text: That's within three percent of the Honda for way less money and it used the least fuel.
ai: a stack of cash next to a small red engine
a fuel can with a few drops left glowing

lines.text: So which one would you buy?
ai: two red small gas engines facing off on a garage floor under dramatic light

title: Which $150 Engine Can Keep Up With a $600 Honda? 🤔 (@ProjectFarm/YT)
description: Project Farm ran a Honda, a Honda clone, a Predator and a Briggs for 48 hours and pulled a trailer with each. The fake's sticker lies, and the cheap surprise is the Predator. Original video: @ProjectFarm https://youtu.be/vtUtORbNLsA | Science explained + AI visuals by our channel.
